description:
The fan-favorite cruiser just got a serious upgrade. The 2025 Around the Block E-Bike keeps its signature simplicity and vintage-inspired charm but now comes packed with thoughtful enhancements to make every ride smoother, safer, and more fun. With integrated front and rear lights, a whisper-quiet motor, and a clean design that hides all the electronics, this bike looks like a classic cruiser—but rides like a modern machine.

At the heart of the ride is a powerful 500-watt motor, giving you three ways to ride: pedal like a traditional bike, switch to pedal assist for a helpful boost when you need it, or use the thumb throttle to let the motor take over completely. Hit speeds of up to 20mph and make hills, wind, and long distances feel like no big deal.

The new integrated lighting system keeps you visible at all hours without extra gear or setup—perfect for evening rides, early commutes, or shaded bike paths. Everything is built into the frame for a seamless look and added peace of mind.

True to its name, this bike is still a breeze for relaxed rides around the block, but the 500Wh battery now lets you go way beyond. You’ll get up to 20 miles in full electric mode and up to 40 miles using pedal assist, depending on how you ride. That means more beach cruises, campus shortcuts, and neighborhood loops—without worrying about running out of juice.

With 26” wheels and 2.125” tires, the Around the Block rolls smoothly and cushions every bump. The upright riding position eases strain on your back, hips, and shoulders, while the front and rear disc brakes provide strong, reliable stopping power.

Whether you're commuting, cruising, or just having fun, the 2025 Around the Block E-Bike is classic comfort, recharged.

2025 Around the Block E-Bike – Key Features:

500W Motor – Choose from full electric, pedal assist, or manual mode

Top Speed of 20mph – Cruise effortlessly wherever you go

500Wh Battery – Up to 20 miles on full electric, 20–40 miles with pedal assist

Integrated Front & Rear Lights – Ride safe with built-in visibility

Front & Rear Disc Brakes – Smooth, dependable stopping power

26" Wheels with 2.125" Tires – Stable, cushioned ride over any terrain

Upright Riding Position – Reduces strain on back, shoulders, and knees

Clean Look with Hidden Cables – Classic style without visible tech

Fits Riders from 5'0" to 6'0" – A comfortable fit for a wide range of heights

Battery Compliant to the UL 2271 Standard as Tested by ACT Labs
